title: Search and book with a Stripe test card and 3-D Secure
summary: A guest pays by card on the Stripe Payment Element with the 3-D Secure test card; the PaymentIntent is authorised, the order created and the payment captured; the sold-out path voids the authorisation.
prerequisites: Real Stripe **test** keys in `ota/backend/.env.local` and `bash tools/dev/stripe-listen.sh --only ota` running with its signing secret in `.env.local` ([[journey:amadeus-and-stripe-connections]], steps "stripe-keys").
Stripe's documented test cards only: `4000 0027 6000 3184` (3-D Secure) and `4242 4242 4242 4242`.

steps.title: Search, choose a fare and open checkout
steps.actions: Search, keep a fare, press **Continue to checkout**.

steps.title: Travellers, contacts and one extra bag
steps.actions: Fill the traveller and contact; in **Extras and special requests** add one checked bag and press **Confirm the new total, €…**; in **Payment** choose **Card**; accept the terms; **Continue to payment**.
steps.expect: Adding the bag re-prices the trip: "With these extras the airline's total is …" and the new total is confirmed before payment ("Extras saved. Your total is …"). The card page opens at `/checkout/pay-card.html?id=chk_…&payment=pay_…`.
steps.data: `checkout_ancillaries`; a child `priced_offers` row (`parent_priced_offer_id`); `checkouts.priced_offer_id` points at it; a `payments` row with `provider = stripe`, `capture_method = manual` and `provider_payment_id = pi_…`.

steps.title: Review the total with the 3-D Secure test card
steps.actions: Type `4000 0027 6000 3184`, any future expiry and any CVC into Stripe's Payment Element, then press **Review total**.
steps.expect: Only this page loads Stripe.js. **Review total** lets Stripe check the form, then the API quotes the card fee of the brand and **Your final total** shows it; the button reads **Pay €…**. Changing the card afterwards drops the review.
steps.data: `payments.card_fee_amount` and `card_fee_lines` updated; the PaymentIntent amount at Stripe equals the total (minor units).

steps.title: Pay and pass the challenge
steps.actions: Press **Pay €…**; complete Stripe's 3-D Secure test challenge.
steps.expect: `/checkout/complete.html` completes the checkout, then `/confirmation.html?booking=bkg_…` shows the reference and the ticketing state (issued under the default *issue after payment* policy).
steps.data: `SELECT status, amount_authorized, amount_captured FROM tenant_<key>.payments WHERE booking_id = 'bkg_…';` → `captured`. `payment_events`: `payment_intent.amount_capturable_updated`, then `succeeded` (from the listener). The listener shows `<-- [200]` for each event. Booking `confirmed` → `ticketed`.

steps.title: Confirmation e-mail and the booking page
steps.actions: Open the confirmation e-mail; open the booking page from the confirmation.
steps.expect: The e-mail carries the itinerary PDF; the booking page opens through the guest cookie; a browser without that cookie cannot open it.

steps.title: Sold out at completion: nothing is charged
steps.actions: Book again with `4242 4242 4242 4242`, adding `X-Stub-Scenario: sold-out` to the `POST /api/v1/checkouts/chk_…/complete` request only.
steps.expect: The complete page says the flight is no longer available and that you have not been charged.
steps.data: The payment is `canceled` in `tenant_<key>.payments` and its PaymentIntent is `canceled` in the Stripe dashboard (test mode); the booking is `failed` (visible in the console only).
